name: liquid-lens
title: Liquid Lens
description: The SVG displacement filter that data-theme="liquid" refracts floating UI through, rendered only where backdrop-filter can use it.
docs: Render `<LiquidLens />` once, anywhere in the page. In Chromium it adds a hidden SVG filter with the id `eskais-liquid-lens`, and the liquid theme adds it to `--floating-backdrop`; elsewhere it renders nothing and the theme keeps blur and saturation. `refraction` is how far the edges shift what's behind, as a fraction of the element's size.
